RESPONDENT:
 STATE OF KERALA  REPRESENTED BY PUBLIC PROSECUTOR,
 HIGH COURT OF KERALA,
 PIN - 682031 OTHER PRESENT:
 SR PP NEETHA S  THIS BAIL APPLICATION HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 11.07.2024, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY PASSED THE FOLLOWING:
 B.A.No.5505/2024  -:2:-
 Dated this the 11th day of July, 2024  ORDER
The application is filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for an order of Aneesh Kumar.

R vs State Of Kerala on 11 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/23164349/
1 pre-arrest bail.

2. The petitioner apprehends arrest by the Vechoochira Police Station, Pathanamthitta, in an unknown crime for allegedly committing the offence under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code,
1860.

3. Heard; Sri. Alex K.John, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and smt.Neema T.V.,
the learned Senior Public Prosecutor.
4.
The learned Public Prosecutor, on instructions, submitted that Crime No.164/2024 has been registered by the Vechoochira Police Station, Pathanamthitta, against the petitioner.
5. On a reading of the bail application, it can be seen that none of the details or materials pertaining to the incident, crime number, the offences or the rank of the accused have been stated.
The bail application is vague and lacks the requisite details, particularly the offences levelled against the petitioner.

It is well-settled in Gurbaksh Singh Sibbia v. State of Punjab [(1980) 2 SCC 565 ] as well as Kusha Duruka v. State of Odisha [2024 (1) KHC 389] that a bail application should contain the elementary details pertaining to the accusations levelled against the accused.

sentences.text: Therefore, I am of the view that the present application is unsustainable in law and the petitioner would be at liberty to file a fresh application after incorporating all the requisite details.

In the result, the bail application is dismissed, without prejudice to the right of the petitioner to file a fresh bail application, if so advised, after incorporating his rank, crime number, the offences and all the accusations levelled against him.

Sd/-
 C.S.DIAS,JUDGE DST/11.07.24 //True copy//
 P.A. To Judge Aneesh Kumar.
